description: Change an invoice: pass invoice_id and at least one of status, amount, currency, due_date and metadata. Needs a claimed Last Price credential with billing write scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

due_date.description: When the invoice is due, as an RFC 3339 date-time.

invoice_id.description: The invoice: its id, as list_invoices shows it.

metadata.description: Anything worth keeping with the record.

name: update_invoice
